_comment: Shape of the Secrets Manager secret 'wedfind-<env>/app'. Terraform seeds DB/Redis/region/bucket/project/frontend/ENV. FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_B64 and SENTRY_DSN are injected out-of-band (rotation runbook) and are ignore_changes in Terraform. AWS keys are intentionally absent — the EC2 role provides S3 access.
FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_B64: <base64 of the rotated service-account JSON — set via rotate-firebase-key.sh>
